# Copilot instructions — ubuteco-react

Read **[AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md)** before suggesting or editing code in this repository.

- Workflow (commits, PRs, quality gates): [docs/workflow-plans-and-git.md](docs/workflow-plans-and-git.md)
- Frontend context: [docs/context/](docs/context/)
- Backend companions: [ubuteco_api/docs/context/](../ubuteco_api/docs/context/)
- Active work: one plan from [docs/plans/README.md](docs/plans/README.md)
- Small fixes: [docs/backlog/README.md](docs/backlog/README.md)

Stack: Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind 4, Vitest + MSW.

Do not port from abandoned Angular `ubuteco_spa`. Business rules live in the API — UI is auth, routing, formatting, and UX.
